name: vix_filtered_index_trend_v126
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when India VIX is in the 12-22 range, institutional algorithmic desks run directional TWAP/VWAP programs that create persistent micro-trends detectable via EMA structure. A fresh bullish EMA crossover (3-min EMA crossing above 9-min EMA) while NIFTY trades above session VWAP signals that buy-side algo flow is gaining momentum — not a random spike, but sustained accumulation that typically extends 20-30 spot points over the next 30-90 seconds. The VIX band filter is critical: below 12, the market is too calm and crossovers are noise with no follow-through; above 22, volatile chop destroys EMA signal fidelity and whipsaws dominate.

indicators.name: ema_fast_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute fast EMA captures momentum shift at the timescale we hold (30-120s). NOT blindly scaled from 9 (9*12=108 would give 9-min, matching original but too slow for our 30s trade trigger). 36 bars detects fresh acceleration in NIFTY's 5s price structure — a fresh cross above the slow EMA within 3 minutes is the signal, not the 9-minute version.

indicators.name: ema_slow_108
indicators.purpose: 9-minute slow EMA provides medium-term trend context. This IS 9*12 (9 bars on 1-min = 108 bars at 5s), which is appropriate here because the slow EMA is a CONTEXT FILTER (not a trade trigger) and should represent roughly the same intraday trend direction window as the original's 21-bar slow EMA on 1-min (21 min ≈ 108 bars at 5s gives 9 min, close enough for filtering).

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.purpose: Cumulative session VWAP, no scaling needed — it resets daily and accumulates from 09:15 regardless of bar size. Filters direction: buy CE only when NIFTY is above VWAP (buy-side in control), buy PE only below VWAP.

indicators.name: india_vix
indicators.purpose: Regime filter inherited directly from original. VIX 12-22 band is the sweet spot where NIFTY's EMA crossovers have follow-through: enough volatility for a 4-7 pt option move but not so much that whipsaws dominate.

conditions: EMA(36) freshly crosses above EMA(108) by > ema_gap_threshold (0.02% of close)
buy_ce.confirmation: Fresh crossover on current bar (previous bar was at or below threshold)

conditions: EMA(36) freshly crosses below EMA(108) by > ema_gap_threshold

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot pts. If a fresh EMA crossover with VWAP alignment is genuine, NIFTY should not retrace 8 spot points within the 30-120s hold window — that would indicate the crossover was a false break, and the thesis is wrong.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 NIFTY spot pts. The first impulse leg after an EMA crossover in a VIX 12-22 regime typically extends 20-30 spot pts; capturing 14 pts (first 50-70%) at delta ~0.5 gives 7 option pts — achievable at the 1-2 min timescale where institutional TWAP flow sustains direction.

filters.vix_filter: VIX between vix_low (default 12) and vix_high (default 22) — inherited directly from original, ensures signal fidelity
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:20 IST (skip pre-open noise, flatten before EOD)
filters.volume_filter: none — index volume is noisy at 5s resolution
filters.trend_filter: VWAP direction (close > vwap for CE, close < vwap for PE)
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — VIX regime shifts can render signal ineffective; EMA crossover signals decay as HFT adapts

adaptation_notes: Original traded nifty200 stocks with EMA(9)/EMA(21) on 1-min bars. Conversion: (1) Universe collapses to NIFTY index directly — no stock selection needed; (2) Fast EMA compressed from 9-min equivalent to 3-min (36 bars) because we're trading the 30-90s impulse, not the 9-min one; (3) Slow EMA kept at ~9-min (108 bars) as context filter; (4) VWAP retained as direction confirmation — cumulative, no scaling; (5) VIX 12-22 band retained as-is — this is index-native and directly applicable; (6) Stop/target converted from ATR-based % to option premium points calibrated to expected 30-120s NIFTY move magnitudes.
weaknesses: EMA crossovers at 5s resolution can be noisy even with the gap threshold filter
VIX lag of 1-5 seconds may miss sudden volatility spikes that invalidate the regime filter
Crossover signals cluster around same market conditions, reducing independence across trades
